description: This file defines the Customer model class for the OpenCart system, encapsulating customer-related database operations such as adding, editing, retrieving, and deleting customers, as well as handling authentication and related activities.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Model class for managing customer data and operations within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record in the database, assigning customer group, store, language, and other details based on provided data and configuration.

methods.name: editCustomer
methods.description: Updates existing customer information in the database identified by customer ID.

methods.name: editPassword
methods.description: Changes the password of a customer identified by email.

methods.name: editCode
methods.description: Updates the verification or reset code associated with a customer's email.

methods.name: editToken
methods.description: Sets or updates the token used for customer session or authentication.

methods.name: editNewsletter
methods.description: Updates the newsletter subscription status for a specific customer.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Removes a customer and all associated data such as activities, addresses, affiliate info, and transactions.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves detailed customer information by customer ID.

methods.name: getCustomerByEmail
methods.description: Fetches customer data using email, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getCustomerByCode
methods.description: Gets customer information using a unique code, excluding empty codes.

methods.name: getCustomerByToken
methods.description: Retrieves customer details using a session or verification token and clears the token after use.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByEmail
methods.description: Counts the total number of customers with a specific email address.

methods.name: deleteHistory
methods.description: Deletes the login history of a customer.

methods.name: deleteIp
methods.description: Removes stored IP addresses related to a customer.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Fetches all IP addresses associated with a customer.

methods.name: getTotalIps
methods.description: Counts the total number of IP addresses associated with a customer.

methods.name: addLogin
methods.description: Records a new login event for a customer including IP and country info.

methods.name: addLoginAttempt
methods.description: Logs an attempt to login using email, used typically for security measures.

methods.name: nAttempt
methods.description: Records a login attempt for an email address, marking a new login or updating the attempt total.

methods.name: deleteLoginAttempts
methods.description: Deletes login attempt records for a specific email.

methods.name: getLoginAttempts
methods.description: Retrieves login attempt data for a given email.

methods.name: addAuthorize
methods.description: Creates a new authorization token record for a customer with associated IP and user agent.

methods.name: editAuthorizeStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a customer authorization record.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotal
methods.description: Updates the total count of authorizations for a customer authorization record.

methods.name: deleteAuthorize
methods.description: Deletes authorization records for a customer, optionally by specific authorization ID.

methods.name: getAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Retrieves authorization details using customer ID and token, including total attempts.

methods.name: resetAuthorizes
methods.description: Resets all authorization attempt counts for a specific customer.
